name: Activity Timeline
description: Every record of the agent's transcript on one UTC time axis, a lane per value of the tactic label, with Search, Filter by, Rows and Color by in the top row, the time range's viewfinder over the lanes, the context compaction flagged on the axis, the records in the range in a table, and a record in the side panel with its reasoning or its tool call and result.

records.name: message
records.one: one record of the transcript: a reasoning turn, a tool call with its result, a human prompt or the system prompt

fields.name: kind
fields.how: a tool message as tool, an assistant message that opens with a thinking tag as thinking else text, a human turn as prompt, the system prompt as system

accepts.means: the record on line <n>, shown on the timeline

units.means: the records between two UTC times, zoomed to them
